paper_title: A Search for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX haloscope search excluding DFSZ axion-photon coupling for axion masses 2.66-2.81 ueV (645-680 MHz, frequency range 645-676 MHz fully excluded). Limit reported at 90% CL, density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (isothermal halo) and 0.63 GeV/cc (N-body). The exclusion plot y-axis is |g_agg| in units of 10^-16 GeV^-1 reaching down near DFSZ (~1e-15 GeV^-1). Exact per-mass values are not tabulated in the text; data_points are approximate representative values near the DFSZ level across the excluded mass range and should be verified against Fig. 4. Masses: 2.66-2.81 ueV = 2.66e-6 to 2.81e-6 eV (note: I converted using the stated ueV range).
